description: Trigger evals for the chaos-vector-catalogue skill dispatch description. 10 should-trigger + 10 should-NOT-trigger. 60/40 train/val split (12 train, 8 val). Validation split is the ship gate: rate >= 0.5 on should-trigger AND < 0.5 on should-not-trigger.

train: find edge cases in apm install
what happens if I pass a bogus apm.yml
explore failure modes in dependency resolution
discover unexpected inputs that crash apm
val: test how apm handles a deleted lockfile mid-run
break the auth resolver in unusual ways
what undocumented inputs would trip apm install
regression-trap a silent failure in marketplace download

train: add unit tests for module X

notes: Should-trigger queries probe failure-mode discovery, fuzzing, undocumented-input exploration, and regression-trap framing -- all distinct from generic coverage or PR review.

Should-not-trigger queries cover sibling primitives: pr-review-panel (PR review), daily-test-improver (coverage), doc-sync (docs), normal bugfix flow, AuthResolver explanation (read-only research), release management, and triage. Sharpens the boundary called out in plan.md Step 5 (DISPATCH COLLISION with test-coverage-expert / daily-test-improver).
